title: MEDMKG: Benchmarking Medical Knowledge Exploitation with Multimodal Knowledge Graph
abstract: arXiv:2505.17214v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Medical deep learning models depend heavily on domain-specific knowledge to perform well on knowledge-intensive clinical tasks. Prior work has primarily leveraged unimodal knowledge graphs, such as the Unified Medical Language System (UMLS), to enhance model performance. However, integrating multimodal medical knowledge graphs remains largely underexplored, mainly due to the lack of resources linking imaging data with clinical concepts. To address this gap, we propose MEDMKG, a Medical Multimodal Knowledge Graph that unifies visual and textual medical information through a multi-stage construction pipeline. MEDMKG fuses the rich multimodal data from MIMIC-CXR with the structured clinical knowledge from UMLS, utilizing both rule-based tools and large language models for accurate concept extraction and relationship modeling. To ensure graph quality and compactness, we introduce Neighbor-aware Filtering (NaF), a novel filtering algorith

translated_title: MEDMKG：基于多模态知识图谱的医学知识利用基准测试
translated_abstract: 医学深度学习模型在执行知识密集型临床任务时，高度依赖领域特定知识才能取得良好表现。先前的研究主要利用单模态知识图谱（如统一医学语言系统UMLS）来提升模型性能。然而，多模态医学知识图谱的整合在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，其主要原因是缺乏将影像数据与临床概念相链接的资源。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MEDMKG——一个医学多模态知识图谱，它通过多阶段构建流程将视觉与文本医学信息统一起来。MEDMKG融合了来自MIMIC-CXR的丰富多模态数据与来自UMLS的结构化临床知识，同时利用基于规则的工具和大语言模型进行准确的概念提取与关系建模。为确保图谱的质量与紧凑性，我们引入了邻居感知过滤——一种新颖的过滤算法……
tldr: 提出了医学多模态知识图谱MEDMKG，通过融合MIMIC-CXR的视觉与文本数据以及UMLS的结构化临床知识构建图谱，并引入邻居感知过滤算法保证图谱质量，为医学知识利用提供了首个多模态知识图谱基准。
